notes:
dunsky_ev_charging_infrastructure: Canadian LD/MHD charging projections with port-count mixes, rated-power trajectories and CAD2022 equipment/installation costs per port. Model cost is total port expenditure divided by total rated power. Aggregated infrastructure retains manual annual utilization 0.20/0.30 for LDV/MHDV; explicit archetypes derive utilization from matched operating inputs and a separately sourced home proxy. Source-specific endpoint holds remain explicit.
  - charger_shares_and_utilization: Aggregated representation retains reviewed manual annual utilization of 0.20 for LDV and 0.30 for MHDV. These values are distinct from explicit type-specific utilization derived from operating inputs. The original rounded MHDV duration/throughput and 80/20 mix rationale remains in the manual input for audit.

source: CANOE Ontario RAMP-mobility simulations, paper-overnight batch (2026-11-13), seed 42; NHTS 2022 or TTS 2016 aggregate travel inputs and 2018 weather; https://github.com/RAMP-project/RAMP-mobility
notes:
legacy_charging_profiles: Ontario RAMP-mobility BEV simulations (2018 Toronto calendar; seed 42), corrected for charging-loss/SOC accounting and UTC weather alignment. Inputs combine survey driving patterns, Ontario driver/vehicle shares, legacy sales-weighted battery capacities, population-weighted Renewables Ninja weather and inherited charger access/power. Embedded fleet/range/charger composition proxies shared LDV charging across selected regions; CANOE rescales hourly shapes to reviewed charger utilization.
  - nhts_uncontrolled: Unweighted filtered NHTS 2022 household-driver travel; midpoint trip-occurrence distributions and mean distance among observed trip-taking persons (zero-trip people excluded). Uncontrolled charging starts at parking arrival when SOC/access gates permit. Low SOC/insufficient next-trip energy permits emergency charging outside preferred windows. Initial/target SOC 80%, charging efficiency 90%; 2,499 rounded drivers.
